purpose: Design-first assertions; not proof of a runnable MTProto implementation.

cases.scenario: A valid session binds only to loopback
cases.expected: Local client can connect; non-loopback interface is not listening
cases.failure: Listener appears on 0.0.0.0 or public interface

cases.scenario: A wrong local secret is rejected
cases.expected: Reject and close without upstream dial; no secret in events
cases.failure: Any upstream dial or sensitive diagnostic
Accept, hang beyond 10s, or leak socket

cases.scenario: Invalid TLS certificate on configured WSS peer
cases.input: Self-signed localhost test certificate not in trust store
cases.expected: Connection fails without fallback to insecure TLS

cases.scenario: Manual relay-only policy with unavailable relay
cases.expected: No direct TCP/WSS fallback; bounded fail

cases.scenario: WSS fails before permitted TCP fallback
cases.input: WSS mock refuses; TCP mock responds
cases.expected: Within one deadline, attempt allowed TCP once; no payload replay
cases.failure: Duplicate forwarded MTProto data or forbidden path

cases.input: Cancel generation=1 during pending dial; start generation=2
cases.expected: Late generation=1 completion cannot create live session
At most 8 owned sessions; extra rejected or queued within bound

cases.input: Slow isolated mock peer; bounded queues
cases.expected: Memory remains bounded; stop unblocks pending writes

cases.scenario: Stop while TLS handshake is stalled
cases.input: Local TLS peer never completes handshake
cases.expected: All owned sockets release; listener port reusable

cases.input: Dummy marker secret and credential-bearing relay URL
cases.expected: No marker, URL path, token, MTProto bytes in any exported event

cases.input: Local fixtures of multiple fragment sizes
cases.expected: Exact reconstructed bytes; max packet is enforced; no replay
cases.failure: Mismatched bytes, oversized accept or out-of-order stream

cases.scenario: Hypothetical optional Worker rejects arbitrary destination
cases.input: Local stub with dst=127.0.0.1 or unknown DC
Handle created, stopped twice, released, reused
cases.expected: Idempotent stop; stale handle is rejected without UAF
